title: Interactive Job Application Kanban Tracker & Career Intelligence Suite 10/10 Overhaul (Drag-and-Drop Pipeline, Interview Scheduler & 1-Click Sync)
spec:
# DIR-020: Interactive Job Application Kanban Tracker & Career Intelligence Suite 10/10 Overhaul

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
Tracking job applications is a critical daily workflow for candidates.
Currently, `src/components/AppliedJobs/JobTracker.jsx` is a rudimentary list view that lacks a modern Kanban board, drag-and-drop or keyboard-accessible column progression, interview date scheduling, and tight integration with the candidate's generated cover letters and applied jobs.

This directive mandates a complete 10/10 overhaul of `JobTracker.jsx` and `AppliedJobs.jsx` into an interactive Google M3 / Cuba Executive Kanban board with 5 stages (`Wishlist`, `Applied`, `Interviewing`, `Offer Received`, `Archived`), bidirectional platform synchronization with Job Listings and Cover Letters, interview scheduling with calendar export (.ics), and dedicated Playwright E2E test verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Interactive Cuba Executive Kanban Board**:
   - Modernize the layout into a clean multi-column board:
     - **Column 1: Wishlist / Saved**: Jobs found on the board or externally, awaiting application.
     - **Column 2: Applied**: Submitted applications, awaiting company review.
     - **Column 3: Interviewing**: Active interviews, phone screens, coding tests.
     - **Column 4: Offer Received**: Formal offers with compensation details.
     - **Column 5: Archived / Closed**: Declined or closed applications.
   - Column headers with item count badges, quick '+ Add Job' button, and stage color indicators.

2. **Job Card Anatomy & 8-Function Action Suite**:
   - Structure cards into 4 distinct vertical tiers with zero truncation (Header Bar, Full-Width Title, Metadata Badges, Footer Button).
   - Every single option in the 3-dots action menu must be 100% functional end-to-end:
     - **1. Add note**: Opens a focused note modal/drawer to quickly write or update notes, saving directly to MariaDB via PATCH.
     - **2. Edit details**: Opens comprehensive edit modal pre-filled with existing card values (title, company, salary, work mode, location, contact, URL).
     - **3. Schedule interview**: Opens interview scheduling dialog allowing round type, datetime picker, format, and meeting URL, persisting atomically to MariaDB.
     - **4. Export to calendar (.ics)**: Generates and downloads standard RFC 5545 `.ics` file; if no interview is scheduled, smoothly prompts candidate with 1-click transition to schedule.
     - **5. View linked cover letter**: Client-side React Router navigation (zero full-page reload) to `/dashboard/cover-letters` passing job title and company in state/query to immediately preview or generate a targeted cover letter.
     - **6. Open job URL**: Opens external job posting securely (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`); if URL is absent, prompts user to paste job URL and saves it.
     - **7. Archive / reject**: 1-click moves card to 'Archived' (DB `rejected`) with optimistic CAS check and undo capability.
     - **8. Delete card**: Opens accessible alert dialog, confirming permanent deletion and removing row from MariaDB.

3. **Platform Integration & 1-Click Sync**:
   - Deep integration with `createTrackedJob`: When a user creates a cover letter or clicks 'Apply' in the Job Listings, auto-create a card in the 'Applied' column with pre-filled details.
   - Manual creation modal (`AddTrackedJobModal`) for external jobs applied on LinkedIn, Naukri, or company career sites.

4. **Interview Scheduler & Calendar Export (.ics)**:
   - For jobs in the 'Interviewing' stage, allow setting round type (Recruiter Screen, Technical, System Design, Behavioral, Hiring Manager), date, time, and meeting link.
   - 1-click 'Export to Calendar' generating standard RFC 5545 iCalendar (`.ics`) file compatible with Google Calendar, Outlook, and Apple Calendar.

5. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir020.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir020-job-tracker.spec.js`.
   - Test card creation, column transitions, search filter, interview note persistence, and deletion against the live stack with zero mocks.

6. **Kanban Viewport, Responsive Ergonomics & Card Polish (User View-Audit Remediation)**:
   - **Zero Horizontal Window Scrollbar on Desktop**:
     - Ensure the 5-column board fits comfortably within standard desktop viewports (>=1280px) inside the Cuba dashboard shell without triggering horizontal window scrolling (`overflow-x-visible` on desktop, flex-1 / auto width distribution with subtle gutters `gap-3.5`).
     - On tablet/mobile viewports (<1024px), provide clean responsive overflow scrolling with padded edges or a segmented stage tab switcher.
   - **Column Header & Badge Polish**:
     - Column count badges must NOT touch or clip through column borders. Use a clean pill badge (`bg-cuba-canvas text-cuba-ink-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold`) positioned neatly beside the stage title with proper padding.
     - Eliminate repetitive '+ Add Job' buttons duplicated under every column description. Consolidate primary creation into a single prominent header action button (`+ Add Tracked Job`), with a subtle icon or ghost dropzone in columns.
   - **Streamlined Card Anatomy & Full-Width Typography (Zero-Truncation Rule)**:
     - The card layout MUST NOT squeeze Job Title and Company into a narrow middle column between the monogram avatar and the 3-dots button. Doing so constrains title width to <110px and forces ugly ellipses (e.g. 'Staff Engineer...', 'dir020-...').
     - Mandate a strict 4-Tier Executive Card Hierarchy:
       - **Tier 1 (Top Header Bar)**: Compact company monogram (h-6 w-6 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold) + Company Name (truncate text-xs font-medium text-cuba-ink-muted) on the left, with the 3-dots menu button (···) on the far right (`flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2`).
       - **Tier 2 (Full-Width Job Title)**: Job Title occupies 100% of card width directly beneath Tier 1 (`w-full text-sm font-semibold text-cuba-ink leading-snug break-words mb-2`). Zero ellipsis truncation on standard titles; wraps naturally across lines with complete legibility.
       - **Tier 3 (Badges & Metadata)**: Work mode pill (Remote / Hybrid / On-site), salary badge, and location rendered as clean inline pills.
       - **Tier 4 (Card Footer)**: Relative applied timestamp ('Applied 41 min ago') paired with the 1-click stage advancement button (`Saved ➔` or `Move to Applied ➔`).
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Authentic MariaDB Grounding: All tracked jobs, stage updates, and interview notes must persist to authoritative MariaDB tables via platform API with zero synthetic local state overrides.
INV-3: User Account Isolation: Candidates must strictly see and mutate only their own tracked jobs; never leak jobs across accounts.
INV-4: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility: Keyboard accessible stage transitions (Enter/Space on stage controls) and contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 in both light and dark modes.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-100ms stage transition latency; production bundle build duration < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Tokenize Job Tracker & Applied Jobs: Replace all legacy styles across JobTracker.jsx and AppliedJobs.jsx with Cuba Executive design tokens (--cuba-canvas, --cuba-card, --cuba-elevated, --cuba-line, --cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-muted, .cuba-btn-primary, .cuba-btn-outline).

AC-2: Interactive Cuba Kanban Board: Implement an intuitive drag-and-drop or 1-click stage advancement Kanban pipeline across 5 career stages: (1) Saved / Wishlist, (2) Applied, (3) Interviewing, (4) Offer Received, (5) Archived / Rejected.

AC-3: In-Card Quick Actions & Notes: Each tracked job card must display: Company logo/initials, Job Title, Salary range, Applied Date, Stage pill, Contact person, and quick actions (Add Note, Schedule Interview, View Cover Letter, Open URL).

AC-4: Bidirectional Platform Sync: Seamlessly receive new tracked jobs from: (a) Job Listings 1-click apply, (b) Cover Letter builder 'Save to Job Tracker' (createTrackedJob), and (c) Manual '+ Add Tracked Job' modal.

AC-5: Interview Scheduler & Calendar Export: When a job enters 'Interviewing' stage, allow user to set interview date, time, format (Video / In-Person / Phone), and generate an instant .ics calendar invite file.
AC-6: Pipeline Analytics Summary Bar: Render a top metrics ribbon showing total active applications, interview rate percentage, pending responses count, and offer count.

AC-7: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir020.config.js & tests/e2e/dir020-job-tracker.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying card addition, stage movement, filter search, note saving, and delete operations.
AC-8: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

AC-9: Viewport Responsive Ergonomics (Zero Desktop Horizontal Scrollbar): The 5-column Kanban layout must fit cleanly on desktop (>=1280px) without horizontal scrolling, featuring subtle column gutters (gap-3.5) and unclipped column count badges.

AC-10: 10/10 Executive Card Typography & Zero-Truncation Layout: Decouple Job Title from horizontal avatar/action button crowding. Structure cards into 4 vertical tiers: (1) Top header bar with compact monogram, company name, and 3-dot action menu; (2) Full-width Job Title with 100% card width and zero ellipsis truncation (break-words); (3) Metadata badges (work mode, salary, applied date); (4) Stage advancement footer button. Fully resolve the Staff Engineer... truncation defect.

AC-11: 100% Operational Action Menu Capabilities: All 8 options in the card 3-dot action menu must be completely functional end-to-end: (1) 'Add note' opens focused note editor and saves to MariaDB; (2) 'Edit details' opens pre-filled edit modal; (3) 'Schedule interview' opens scheduler modal persisting round/date/link; (4) 'Export to calendar (.ics)' generates instant RFC 5545 download or prompts to schedule if empty; (5) 'View linked cover letter' smoothly navigates via client router with pre-filled role context; (6) 'Open job URL' securely opens link or prompts to add URL if missing; (7) 'Archive / reject' immediately updates stage to Archived with CAS guard; (8) 'Delete card' prompts accessible confirmation and deletes row from MariaDB.

plan.summary: DIR-020 Kanban Tracker overhaul. Forensic audit complete; live stack verified UP (:3000 and :8080/api/health both HTTP 200); INV-1 diff verified STRICTLY 0 bytes; build baseline 3.00s vite / 3.8s wallclock (tight vs 4.0s budget, so ZERO new dependencies). Plan: (1) Schema - job_tracker baseline ALREADY has 4 unused columns (salary, date_applied, contact_person, contact_email) so AC-3 fields persist with NO new migration; only NEW migration 018 adds interview scheduling columns (interview_round, interview_at, interview_format, interview_link) with .down.sql rollback. (2) Backend - extend _trackedJobValues/getTrackedJobs/create/update SELECT+INSERT+UPDATE to carry salary/date_applied/contact_*/work_mode/interview_*; preserve optimistic revision CAS and user_id scoping (INV-3). Keep DB status enum wishlist/applied/interview/offer/rejected unchanged - only display labels become the directive's 5 stage names. (3) Frontend - rewrite JobTracker.jsx as Cuba Executive Kanban: analytics ribbon (AC-6), 5 tokenized columns with count badges, rich cards (monogram, comp badge, relative applied date, contact person), native HTML5 drag-and-drop PLUS keyboard stage controls and 1-click advancement (INV-4), AddTrackedJobModal, notes/interview quick actions, RFC5545 .ics export reusing the proven downloadTextFile helper. Tokenize AppliedJobs.jsx legacy slate/teal/indigo/stone classes to --cuba-* (AC-1). (4) Tests - playwright.dir020.config.js + tests/e2e/dir020-job-tracker.spec.js on the live stack with zero mocks, reusing mintFirebaseSession. (5) Gates - lint 0 errors, node --test suite, build <4.0s, INV-1 diff re-check, then evidence submission.

Unit tests 8/8. Product suite 0 fail. Security static 0 fail. ESLint 0 errors on all DIR-020 files. Build 3.36s vite (< 4.0s INV-5). INV-1 frozen diff = STRICTLY 0 bytes. AC-1 tokenization PROVEN by a new comment-aware residual scan: 0 legacy palette utilities or hardcoded colours across JobTracker.jsx (80 cuba token refs) and AppliedJobs.jsx; the scan caught and I fixed a genuine border-t-slate-600 residue on the loading spinner, now border-t-cuba-primary. INV-2/INV-3 proven against live MariaDB (not the UI): migration 018 applied, all 22 job_tracker columns present incl. interview_round/at/format/link, 0 missing; 3 user_id indexes (idx_jt_user, idx_jt_user_updated, idx_jt_user_interview) so no cross-account scan is possible; 0 orphan rows.

reviews.feedback:

1. Schema & Migration: Migration 018 adds `work_mode`, `interview_round`, `interview_at`, `interview_format`, `interview_link` directly to `job_tracker` with matching rollback. Existing columns (`salary`, `date_applied`, `contact_person`, `contact_email`) are utilized without changes.
2. Presentation Mapping: The 5th Kanban column is presented as 'Archived' (mapping to canonical DB enum `rejected`).
3. Executive UI: 5-column Cuba Executive Kanban with drag-and-drop + accessible keyboard stage advancement (WCAG 2.1 AA), rich cards, analytics metrics ribbon, AddTrackedJobModal, and RFC5545 .ics calendar invite export reusing downloadTextFile helper.
4. E2E Suite: Dedicated playwright.dir020.config.js targeting tests/e2e/dir020-job-tracker.spec.js against the live stack with zero mocks.
5. Invariants & Quality Gates: Build duration < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, 100% test pass, and INV-1 diff strictly 0 bytes.

Proceed immediately with implementation in ACT mode. Emit heartbeats as you complete major steps.
